x: Art. 312: Parliament may create a new All-India Service if the Rajya Sabha so resolves by two-thirds of members present and voting.

s: Which Article of the Indian Constitution empowers the Parliament to legislate on a subject of state list?
x: Art. 249: on a Rajya Sabha two-thirds resolution, Parliament may legislate on a State List subject in the national interest.

s: Which one of the following comes under the exclusive power of the Council of States :
o: Creation of new All India Services
Election of Vice-President of India during casual
Abolition of Legislative Council of any State
x: Creating new All-India Services (Art. 312) is an exclusive power of the RS; the VP's removal needs both Houses, and abolition of a Council (Art. 169) is by Parliament on the Assembly's resolution.

s: Out of the following, which is NOT a power granted to Rajya Sabha?
o: Authorizing Parliament in the national interest to make a law on a matter in the State List
Authorizing State Assemblies in the national interest to make law on matters in the Union List
To return a Money Bill with recommendations 8
Authorizing Parliament in the national interest to make a law for creation of an All India Service
x: The RS can authorise Parliament (Arts. 249, 312) and returns Money Bills with recommendations, but it cannot authorise State Assemblies to legislate on Union List matters.

s: The two Houses of Parliament
o: Do not differ from each other in any respect
Are constituted to make the role of Lok Sabha secondary to Rajya Sabha
Do not enjoy a co-equal status
x: The Houses are not co-equal: the Lok Sabha is superior in money matters and ministerial responsibility, though equal in others; the RS is indirectly elected, the LS directly.

s:
Which of the following statements about Rajya Sabha is/are correct?

A. The Fifth Schedule of the Constitution deals with the allocation of seats in the Rajya Sabha to the states and union territories.

B. The candidates contesting an election to the Rajya Sabha from a particular state should be an elector in that particular state.

s: Which of the following statements is correct with regard to giving a decision by the President of India on a question whether a member of Parliament has become subject of disqualification for holding any office of profit under the Government of India or the Government of any State?
o: Before giving any decision, the President is to obtain the opinion of the Election Commission and he may or may not accept such opinion

Before giving any decision, the President is to obtain the opinion of the Election Commission and act according to such opinion
The President is to make a reference to the Supreme Court whose decision will be binding on the President
